top_signals.title: Inflation-Wary Shoppers Prepare for Black Friday
top_signals.summary: Retailers had plenty of reasons to be worried about this year’s holiday season, but the latest round of earnings, from Dick’s Sporting Goods Inc. to Kohl’s Corp. and Dollar Tree Inc., show that shoppers are still spending briskly, despite their concerns about rising costs. Bloomberg's Shaquille Omari reports from New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump’s China Tariffs Threaten Fresh Trade Tensions
top_signals.summary:
China has vowed to defend its interests after the US unveiled new tariffs on Chinese goods and warned the rate could double if trade talks collapse, injecting fresh tension ahead of a planned meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

Stocks rose as investors in Europe and Asia tracked a comeback in technology shares on Wall Street, with days of sharp swings likely to give way to thin holiday trading.

UniCredit proposed CEO Andrea Orcel as chairman of Commerzbank’s supervisory board as the Italian lender moves to take control of the German rival in one of Europe’s largest cross-border banking deals in decades.

Today’s guests: Jimmy Muchechetere, Investec Senior Equity Analyst; Ahmed Rostom, Egyptian Minister of Planning & Economic Development; Isabella Weber, University of Massachusetts Amherst Associate Economics Professor & Author of ‘Anti-Fascist Economics’; Antonia Hmaidi, Mercator Institute for China Studies Program Lead (Source: Bloomberg)
